title: The total-cone comparison commutes with differentials
statement: The explicit signed degreewise comparison [def-sc-preorder-bar-total-cone] commutes with the total-bar and mapping-cone differentials in every integer degree.

source.place: The source-bar, least-block unit contraction, and finite-cone-block paragraphs.

proof.text: Test on a bar generator and then on its source and target cone inclusions. Cone maps commute with these inclusions, and totalArrow acts on the coefficient by φ. On the source inclusion the horizontal coefficients are (-1)^(p-1) and -(-1)^p, which agree; the internal cone-source coefficients both reduce to -1. The off-diagonal terms both have coefficient (-1)^p. On the target inclusion the face and internal terms match directly. Use the generator differential formula and the standard cone inclusion-differential identities. In horizontal degree zero the face contribution is zero. All remaining scalar equalities follow from the square and successor formulas for (-1)^p.

theorem coneTotalXHom_comm (n : ℤ) :
    coneTotalXHom φ n ≫ (CochainComplex.mappingCone (totalArrow φ)).d n (n + 1) =
      (total (coneDiagram φ)).d n (n + 1) ≫ coneTotalXHom φ (n + 1)
